title: The Seven Churches (1-4)
intro: Jesus sends letters to seven churches in Asia Minor. Each letter contains praise, criticism (except for Smyrna and Philadelphia), and a promise to the one who overcomes.

persons.name: Ephesus
persons.description: Has left their first love, but hates the deeds of the Nicolaitans.
persons.note: Praise: perseverance. Criticism: lost their love

persons.name: Smyrna
persons.description: Poor, yet rich. Will be persecuted for ten days. No criticism.
persons.note: Praise: faithful in tribulation. Criticism: none

persons.name: Pergamum
persons.description: Holds fast to Jesus' name, but has some who hold to the teaching of Balaam.
persons.note: Praise: faithfulness. Criticism: tolerates false teaching

persons.name: Thyatira
persons.description: Love and faith, but tolerates "Jezebel" who leads people into immorality.
persons.note: Praise: growth. Criticism: tolerates a false prophetess
